hero.subtitle: Sawtak connects citizens directly with members of parliament — submit your issue, track its resolution, and confirm the outcome. Everything is digital, transparent, and secure.

features.easy_report_desc: Submit your issue in less than 30 seconds with image upload and instant classification.
features.privacy_desc: Your data is protected with advanced encryption. No public sharing without your permission.
features.analytics_desc: Comprehensive statistics to help MPs make faster and more accurate decisions.
features.realtime_desc: Track your issue status in real-time with instant notifications on every update.
features.coverage_desc: Connecting citizens with MPs across all governorates and constituencies.
features.review_desc: A specialized team reviews and classifies every issue professionally before presenting it.
